## Architecture Overview

The AlertRule storage interface in Grafana is defined across multiple interface definitions in `pkg/services/ngalert/`. The primary `RuleStore` interface in `provisioning/persist.go` has methods like `GetAlertRuleByUID`, `ListAlertRules`, `InsertAlertRules`, etc. Adding `ListByDatasource` requires updating the interface, the DB implementation, and all mocks/fakes.

## Detailed Analysis

### Interface Definitions (Must Add Method)

- **`provisioning/persist.go`** — Primary `RuleStore` interface with `ListAlertRules`, `ListAlertRulesPaginated`, `InsertAlertRules`, `UpdateAlertRules`, `DeleteAlertRulesByUID`.
- **`api/persist.go`** — API `RuleStore` interface with folder/namespace awareness.
- **`notifier/silence_svc.go`** — Minimal `RuleStore` interface for silence service (only `ListAlertRules`).
- **`state/historian/annotation.go`** — `RuleStore` interface for annotation historian.

### DB Implementation

- **`store/alert_rule.go`** — `DBstore` implementation with all CRUD methods. Must implement `ListByDatasource` with SQL query.

### Test Fakes

- **`tests/fakes/rules.go`** — `FakeRuleStore` mock implementing RuleStore. Must implement `ListByDatasource`.

### Test Files

- **`store/alert_rule_test.go`** — Unit tests for store. Needs new test cases.
- **`provisioning/alert_rules_test.go`** — Tests alert rules provisioning.
- **`api/api_prometheus_test.go`** — Prometheus API tests.
- **`api/api_ruler_test.go`** — Ruler API tests.

### Mimir Ruler (Separate Interface)

- **`mimir/pkg/ruler/rulestore/store.go`** — Mimir's own `RuleStore` interface (user/namespace/group based). Different from Grafana's.
- **`mimir/pkg/ruler/rulestore/bucketclient/bucket_client.go`** — Bucket-based RuleStore implementation.

### Loki Ruler (Separate Interface)

- **`loki/pkg/ruler/rulestore/store.go`** — Loki's own `RuleStore` interface. Similar to Mimir's.
- **`loki/pkg/ruler/rulestore/bucketclient/bucket_client.go`** — Bucket-based implementation.

## Relevant Files

| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/provisioning/persist.go | Primary RuleStore interface definition |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/api/persist.go | API RuleStore interface |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/store/alert_rule.go | DBstore implementation of RuleStore |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/tests/fakes/rules.go | FakeRuleStore mock implementation |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/store/alert_rule_test.go | Unit tests for store |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/provisioning/alert_rules_test.go | Tests for alert rules provisioning |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/models/alert_rule.go | AlertRule model with datasource references |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/notifier/silence_svc.go | Minimal RuleStore interface for silence service |
| grafana | pkg/services/ngalert/state/historian/annotation.go | RuleStore interface for historian |
| mimir | pkg/ruler/rulestore/store.go | Mimir's own RuleStore interface |
| loki | pkg/ruler/rulestore/store.go | Loki's own RuleStore interface |
